data.name: Pranay
data.gender_notes: Pranay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pranay means 'love', 'desire', or 'breath'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'prana' meaning 'breath' and 'ay' meaning 'love'. This name reflects the deep connection between the breath of life and the emotions of love and desire. The name Pranay carries the meaning “Love, Desire, Breath” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Pranay usually hope their child will grow to embody love, desire, breath and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pranay is a spiritual name that represents the connection between the individual soul and the divine breath of life. It is a reminder of the importance of maintaining a healthy connection to the divine and allowing the breath of life to flow freely through the body and mind.
data.etymology: Pranay belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Love, Desire, Breath.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pranay total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
